item.title: Luan 0.1.0 (Build 20)
item.description:
• Settings icons now fit their symbols into the same frame, with spacing that matches System Settings, so the sidebar no longer feels crowded.
  • Solid symbols such as the checkmark, cross and play icons are slightly smaller, so every icon carries a similar visual weight.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. Test license activation is still simulated and does not represent a purchase.
